pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is heterogeneous, with larger, elongated regions on the upper flank transitioning to smaller, more compact shapes on the lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial (Y-shaped) and tetra-radial (X-shaped) intersections. Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, low-amplitude serrated contour along the cervical spine, displaying a high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of avian symbionts (oxpeckers) on the rump and mid-dorsal ridge, creating localized textural disruptions on the primary pelage pattern.
